latest_message.content: --- name: bookinfo description: Query the Bookinfo microservices in the Kubernetes cluster. Use this skill for anything about books, book details, reviews, ratings. Triggers on "书籍", "书店", "book", "details", "reviews", "ratings", "bookinfo". metadata: {"openclaw": {"emoji": "📚", "requires": {"bins": ["curl"]}}} --- # Bookinfo Skill ## 重要规则 - 必须使用 exec 工具执行以下 curl 命令 - 查询不是使用 web_search - 将命令中的 {id} 替换为用户指定的数字，默认为 0 ## Services | Service | URL | |-------------|-----------------------------------------------------| | productpage | http://productpage.bookinfo.svc.cluster.local:9080 | | details | http://details.bookinfo.svc.cluster.local:9080 | | reviews | http://reviews.bookinfo.svc.cluster.local:9080 | | ratings | http://ratings.bookinfo.svc.cluster.local:9080 | ## Commands ### Get book details 使用 exec 工具执行： curl -s "http://details.bookinfo.svc.cluster.local:9080/details/{id}" ### Get reviews 使用 exec 工具执行： curl -s "http://reviews.bookinfo.svc.cluster.local:9080/reviews/{id}" ### Get ratings 使用 exec 工具执行： curl -s "http://ratings.bookinfo.svc.cluster.local:9080/ratings/{id}" ### Get productpage 使用 exec 工具执行： curl -s "http://productpage.bookinfo.svc.cluster.local:9080/productpage?u=normal" ## Notes - Always use cluster-internal DNS, not external IPs. - reviews service load-balances across v1/v2/v3 with different response formats.
